entries.target: For each pattern, look at the structure first, then say the examples out loud. Press the audio button to hear the Japanese sentence.

entries.source: কোন tool/মাধ্যম দিয়ে কাজ করা হচ্ছে তা で দিয়ে বলা হয়।
entries.target: The tool or means used to do something is marked with で.

entries.source: Lesson 6-এর で ছিল action place; এখানে で = by/with।
entries.target: In Lesson 6, で marked the place of an action; here で = by/with.
Hashi de gohan wo tabemasu.
I eat rice with chopsticks.
Nihongo de repooto wo kakimasu.
I write reports in Japanese.
Enpitsu de namae wo kakimasu.
I write my name with a pencil.

entries.source: কোনো শব্দ অন্য ভাষায় কী, তা জিজ্ঞাসা করতে।
entries.target: For asking what a word is in another language.
Very useful for finding meanings in Bengali, English and Japanese.

entries.source: 「 Thank you」 ওয়া নিহোনগো দে নানিদেসু কা।
entries.target: 「Thank you」 wa nihongo de nan desu ka.
What is “Thank you” in Japanese?
「Arigatou」 desu.
Arigatou.
I or someone gives something to someone else.
The recipient/person is usually marked with に.

entries.source: ওয়াতাশি ওয়া তোমোদাচি নি হানা ও আগেমাসু।
entries.target: Watashi wa tomodachi ni hana wo agemasu.
I give flowers to my friend.
Haha ni purezento wo agemashita.
I gave a present to my mother.
Receiving or getting something from someone.

entries.source: source/person に বা から — দুটোই দেখা যায়; から বেশি স্পষ্ট “থেকে”।
entries.target: The source/person takes に or から — both are seen; から is the clearer “from”.

entries.source: ওয়াতাশি ওয়া সেনসেই নি হোন ও মোরাইমাশিতা।
entries.target: Watashi wa sensei ni hon wo moraimashita.

entries.source: আমি শিক্ষকের কাছ থেকে বই পেয়েছি।
entries.target: I received a book from my teacher.
Tomodachi kara shashin wo moraimashita.
I received a photo from my friend.

entries.source: কাজ হয়ে গেছে বলতে もう; এখনো হয়নি হলে まだです।
entries.target: To say something is already done, use もう; if it is not done yet, まだです.
Mou shukudai wo shimashita ka.
Have you done your homework?
Hai, mou shimashita.
Yes, I have done it.
Iie, mada desu.
No, not yet.
Speaking Practice

entries.source: এই বাক্যগুলো interview/classroom conversation-এর মতো করে ৩ বার করে পড়ুন।
entries.target: Read these sentences aloud 3 times, as if in an interview or classroom conversation.
Nan de gohan wo tabemasu ka.
What do you eat rice with?
Hashi de tabemasu.
I eat with chopsticks.

entries.source: তানজো বি নি নানি ও মোরাইমাশিতা কা।
entries.target: Tanjoubi ni nani wo moraimashita ka.
What did you receive on your birthday?
Tomodachi ni hon wo moraimashita.
I received a book from my friend.
Test Yourself
Which one means “No, not yet”?
